policy: Only reviewed Bengali-script pronunciation is published; no automatic transliteration is generated. User-approved conventions: preserve the Arabic ayah, use readable Bengali phonetic spelling, and end each line with Bengali danda (।). Bengali transliteration is a reading aid, not tajwid instruction.

coverage.basis: Previously reviewed coverage recorded in the project.
2:2-3 confirmed/corrected by the user; 2:4-30 reviewed and corrected against the repository Arabic plus the Bangladesh government transliteration reference, independently worded.

verified.note: Only explicitly confirmed or individually rechecked ayahs are counted here.

draft_candidates.status: All 6236 text fields remain stored; only the reviewed coverage above is shown. The remaining 6200 await the next review batches.

source: Repository Arabic text is the base. quran.gov.bd Bengali transliteration policy/reference is used for review, not copied into the site.
